concepts.prompt: A frame from a soft hand-painted anime film. Golden-hour light in a teen girl's bedroom: she holds a slightly cloudy clear retainer up to the window and frowns. Her mother stands at the door smiling, holding the white DentalPULSE ultrasonic cleaner from the reference photo (accurate white ribbed dome). Lush painterly background, gentle watercolor light, small sparkles of light. Headline in clean soft lettering at the top: "Cloudy retainer? That's film, not age." Small line at the bottom: "5 minutes. Tap water."

concepts.angle: Scratch-card pattern interrupt revealing 40% OFF $99.95
concepts.based_on: Account winner '40% Off + Free Gifts' (ROAS 1.92); pattern-interrupt native object formats (analysis §7 real-world objects); offer 40% OFF $99.95 + 120-day guarantee.
concepts.headline: You've won 40% OFF the ultrasonic cleaner.
concepts.prompt: A close-up photo of a hand holding a silver coin scratching a scratch-off card; the scratched area reveals bold text "40% OFF" and "$99.95". The card is printed in blue and white and shows a clear retainer and the white DentalPULSE ultrasonic cleaner from the reference photo as small artwork on the card, with silver scratch dust. Bold headline above the card: "You've won 40% OFF the ultrasonic cleaner." Small line below: "120-Day Money-Back Guarantee."

concepts.angle: Native store UI: 'frequently bought together' trio with total and savings (Ultimate Bundle, offer-only)
concepts.based_on: Store Ultimate Cleaning Bundle $169.95 vs $300 (save $130); Smyle/Hismile cart and checkout UI frames (analysis §6).
concepts.headline: Frequently bought together: save $130.
concepts.prompt: A realistic mobile store screen, light mode, no platform logo. A section titled "Frequently bought together" with three product thumbnails joined by plus signs, exactly as in the reference bundle photo: the white DentalPULSE ultrasonic cleaner, the small round white Travel Pod, and the blue box of retainer cleaner tablets. Below: "Total price $169.95" with "$300" struck through and a green "SAVE $130" tag, and a big blue button "Add all 3 to cart". Bold headline above the screen: "Frequently bought together: save $130."

concepts.angle: Native dating-app profile (no logo): aligner hygiene as a green flag
concepts.based_on: analysis §7 native UI (dating-app profile); survey aligner: 'white film', 'trays looked cloudy' (aligners happiest segment 4.36 stars); aligner persona 25-45.
concepts.headline: Green flag: clean aligners.
concepts.prompt: A realistic dating-app style profile screenshot, light mode, no logos. A large photo of a smiling woman about 30 holding clear aligners, name "Priya, 31", then prompt cards: "Green flag I look for: clean aligners." and "My most irrational fear: that white film." and "Second photo: the open DentalPULSE ultrasonic cleaner from the reference photo with an aligner inside, captioned 'Me, every night, 5 minutes.'" Bold headline over the top of the screen: "Green flag: clean aligners."

concepts.angle: Native UI: story poll sticker over a lifestyle photo
concepts.based_on: Survey aligner 'not sure if it was being cleaned', 'always seeing a film even after brushing'; native UI formats (analysis §7); poll bars unlabeled with numbers to avoid fake stats.
concepts.headline: How do you clean your aligners?
concepts.prompt: A vertical photo in the style of a social story: a clean desk with an aligner case, a latte and the white DentalPULSE ultrasonic cleaner from the reference photo in the soft-focus background. A poll sticker in the middle with the question "How do you clean your aligners?" and four rounded answer bars with no percentages: "Rinse and pray", "Toothbrush", "Crystals", "Ultrasonic cleaner". Small handwritten-style text at the bottom: "Rinsing isn't cleaning."

concepts.angle: Wanted poster: reward = the Ultimate Cleaning Bundle price (offer-only)
concepts.based_on: Survey aligner quotes: 'White film', 'No white film!'; store Ultimate Cleaning Bundle $169.95 vs $300; real-world object format.
concepts.headline: Wanted: the white film on your aligners.
concepts.prompt: A vintage wanted poster pinned to a wooden wall, aged paper with torn edges. Bold black type: "WANTED" at the top, a sketch of a cloudy aligner with a white film, and the lines "The white film on your aligners" and "Last seen: your mouth, 22 hours a day." Along the bottom: "REWARD: Ultimate Cleaning Bundle $169.95 (was $300)." Pinned next to it a photo of the white DentalPULSE ultrasonic cleaner, the small round white Travel Pod and the blue tablet box exactly as in the reference bundle photo. Headline stamped across the top: "Wanted: the white film on your aligners."

concepts.angle: Retro 1930s cartoon: sleeping man with a snore/apnea mouthpiece and germs
concepts.based_on: Notion DEN186/DEN188 sleep-apnea retainer; feedback: sleep-apnea guard 'wasn't sure if it was killing all of the bacteria'; sleep-apnea ~5% of the non-denture half (1 concept). Flag: fit of larger apnea devices not confirmed.
concepts.headline: You wear it every night. When did you last really clean it?
concepts.prompt: A 1930s rubber-hose cartoon still in sepia with one accent color (blue): a sleeping man in a nightcap snoring in bed, wearing a snore mouthpiece, with a cloud of tiny wobbly germs floating above it and a moon in the window. On the nightstand the white DentalPULSE ultrasonic cleaner from the reference photo is the only thing in full modern color. Old-timey title-card lettering across the top: "You wear it every night. When did you last really clean it?" Film grain and vignette.

notes: Friday net-new batch W43 (Oct 16 2026). 40 concepts: 20 dentures / 10 night guards / 6 retainers / 3 aligners / 1 sleep apnea; 26 top-of-funnel + 14 offer; 32 net_new + 8 winning-format. Every concept a different format (analysis §7 + §9, notion_brief §6). 7 cartoon formats. Ultimate bundle only in offers (W43_28, 36, 39); Denture bundle in 14, 15, 19. Flags: health stats (10 billion bacteria) and the pool-shock/FDA tablet story come from the Notion brief and need verification before launch. No Drive verdicts logged (sheets had no filled-in rows).
